locations.name: Astronomers' Guild Outpost
locations.description: Morning rain taps against the outpost windows. Maps of the northern sky cover one wall, while a brass receiver on the central table repeats three pale flashes: the obsolete distress code of the Locked Observatory. Archivist Mara Venn waits beside a sealed dispatch.

exits.label: Take the old road toward the observatory

requirement.failureMessage: You have no reason to investigate the observatory without accepting Mara Venn's sealed dispatch.

locations.name: Hillside Path
locations.description: The abandoned road climbs through wet pines toward the ridge. Above them, the observatory dome catches no daylight, yet a narrow slit in its roof pulses with a cold blue glow.

exits.label: Follow the signal up the ridge

interactions.label: Watch the observatory's signal
interactions.completionMessage: Three short flashes repeat against the clouds. The interval is exact, but every seventh sequence ends with a fourth pulse that is not part of any Guild distress code.

locations.name: Observatory Grounds
locations.description: An iron fence leans around an overgrown courtyard. No footprints disturb the moss, but the great entrance doors stand slightly open. A weathered plaque names Dr. Elian Rook as director and Tomas Venn as caretaker.

locations.name: Entrance Hall
locations.description: Dust lies thick across the black-and-white floor. Brass doors lead deeper into the observatory, and a row of memorial portraits watches from the walls. Dr. Rook's portrait has been turned to face the stone.

locations.name: Main Hall
locations.description: A grand staircase curves beneath a ceiling painted with constellations. The mechanical clock above it stopped at 2:17, though something inside the walls continues to count. A narrow door beneath the landing bears a tarnished caretaker's plaque.

exits.label: Climb the staircase to the observatory

requirement.failureMessage: The staircase is locked. You need a key to proceed.
The chart room is locked with the same seven-star mechanism as the staircase.

locations.name: Caretaker's Study
locations.description: Maintenance ledgers cover a cramped desk beneath the staircase mechanism. A cot remains neatly made in the corner. Among a ring of ordinary iron keys, one piece of engraved brass catches the light.

items.takeLabel: Take the caretaker's journal from the desk

locations.name: Chart Room
locations.description: Tall cabinets divide the room into narrow aisles. Most charts show familiar constellations, but the final season of observations has been scraped from the catalogue. A padded case rests beneath the central table.

items.takeLabel: Lift the telescope lens from its padded case

locations.name: Observatory
locations.description: A vast telescope fills the circular chamber, fixed on a patch of apparently empty sky. Its focusing assembly stands open, missing a lens. Beneath the floor, machinery keeps pace with the signal flashing from the dome.

exits.label: Descend back to the main hall
Open the sealed door to the star chamber

requirement.failureMessage: The star chamber remains sealed. Its mechanism appears to be connected to the telescope.

interactions.label: Repair the telescope
interactions.completionMessage: You carefully fit the lens into the telescope. As its mechanism returns to life, gears turn within the wall and release the seal on the star chamber.

requirement.failureMessage: You need the telescope lens to repair the telescope.

locations.name: Star Chamber
locations.description: A hidden chamber lies beneath a dome of dark glass. Silver lines trace unfamiliar constellations across the floor, converging on an empty pedestal. In the glass overhead, one patch of darkness remains fixed while the stars move around it.

interactions.label: Examine the empty pedestal
interactions.completionMessage: The pedestal is not truly empty. A shallow impression in its surface matches the seven-star seal, and fresh warmth rises from the silver channels around it. Whatever completed the circuit was removed recently.
